data.name: dumbbell reverse wrist curl
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a bench or chair with your feet planted.
Step:2 Take a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing down.
Step:3 Keep the elbows relaxed so the small muscles of the hand or forearm take the load.
Step:4 Move through the wrists or fingers while the forearms stay supported and still.
Step:5 Use a small, smooth range without swinging the elbows.
Step:6 Ease back to the start without letting the load fall from your hands.
